name: Get campaign statistics
description: Call this when you need delivery, open, click, unsubscribe and conversion counters for one or more email campaigns you already know the numeric IDs of, including comparing several campaigns in a single call. Use campaigns.get_campaign instead when you need a campaign's configuration, content or status rather than its performance numbers, and use the campaign listing action first if you still need to discover campaign IDs.
preconditions: Each campaign ID passed must belong to an existing email campaign in the authenticated account.
Statistics are only meaningful for campaigns that have already been sent; unsent campaigns return no counters.
The session must be authenticated against the Brevo web app backend (email-campaigns-backend.brevo.com).

campaignIds.description: Comma-separated list of numeric email campaign IDs to fetch statistics for, e.g. "2" or "3,2". IDs with no statistics are omitted from the response.

campaignClickStats.description: Map keyed by campaign ID (as a string) to that campaign's statistics. Requested IDs with no available statistics are absent from the map.

sent.description: Number of messages sent for the campaign.

clicker.description: Number of unique recipients who clicked.

viewed.description: Number of recipients recorded as having viewed the campaign.

unsubStats.description: Number of unsubscribes attributed to the campaign.

smtpDelivered.description: Number of messages accepted for delivery by the receiving servers.

knownOpens.description: Opens confirmed by tracking, excluding estimated ones.

estimatedOpens.description: Opens inferred rather than directly confirmed.

proxyViewedUnique.description: Unique opens recorded through an image proxy.

opensWithAppleMpp.description: Opens attributed to Apple Mail Privacy Protection prefetching.

opensWithAppleMppRatePercentage.description: Apple MPP opens as a percentage.

conversionCount.description: Number of conversions attributed to the campaign.

conversionAmount.description: Total monetary value of attributed conversions.

calculatedOpens.description: Open count after Brevo's adjustment for privacy-driven prefetching.

calculatedOpenRate.description: Adjusted open count as a rate.

calculatedClickRate.description: Adjusted click count as a rate.
